title: 달빛 시계공방
description: 달빛 아래 잠든 마법 시계공방에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A cozy enchanted clockmaker workshop at night with a large round moonlit window in the center, a wooden workbench, an ornate brass mantel clock, a small blue cuckoo clock on the left wall, a crescent-shaped desk lamp, organized gears and tools, a sleepy black cat on a teal cushion, hanging pocket watches, glass jars, and tiny star-shaped charms
style: premium whimsical storybook illustration, deep indigo, teal, walnut and warm brass palette, crisp object silhouettes, richly detailed but uncluttered, cinematic moonlight and amber lamplight
changeGuidance: Make exactly five localized changes: remove the star charm hanging inside the moonlit window, change the left blue cuckoo clock pendulum from a crescent to a round disk, remove the red-handled screwdriver from the right side of the workbench, add a small golden bell to the black cat's teal collar, and change the large brass mantel clock face from Roman numerals to simple dot hour markers. Preserve everything else exactly.
